The frontend mutation hook is `useCreateMemo` in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`.

The remaining hops are:

- `web/src/connect.ts` (client)
- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (RPC)
- `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (handler)
- `store/memo.go` (store method)
- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (dialect driver)

message.text: The complete 6-hop call chain is now clear. Each hop will be listed as a file path on its own line. SQLite will serve as the dialect driver.

q24.
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts
web/src/connect.ts
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto

`useCreateMemo` calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo` (`connect.ts`). That is `rpc CreateMemo` on `MemoService`, handled by `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`, then `Store.CreateMemo`, then the SQLite `INSERT INTO memo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`.
